name: stfd-desktop-app
description: Springfield Township Fire Department kiosk dashboard

scripts.bundle: node scripts/prepare-build.js && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i ./styles/tailwind.css -o ./app/styles.css --minify && esbuild ./src/firebase-client.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=STFDFirebaseBundle --outfile=./app/firebase-client.js --minify && esbuild ./src/safe-browser.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=./app/safe-content.js --minify && esbuild ./src/admin-icons.css --bundle --outdir=./app --loader:.woff2=file --loader:.woff=file --asset-names=fonts/[name] --minify && node scripts/update-csp.js
scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run check && npm test && node scripts/package-windows.js --publish never
scripts.release: npm run bundle && npm run check && npm test && node scripts/package-windows.js --publish always

author: Springfield Township Fire Department
